question.text: A square aluminium (shear modulus is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>25</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>9</mn></msup><msup><mi>Nm</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>) slab of side <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>60</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> and thickness <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>15</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> is subjected to a shearing force (on its narrow face) of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>18</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>4</mn></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math>. The lower edge is riveted to the floor. The displacement of the upper edge is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>μ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>.
